verses.text: This is the message that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
"Get up and go down to the potter's house, and there I will give you my message."
So I went down to the potter's house, and I saw him working at his wheel.
But the pot he was shaping from the clay was ruined in his hands. So the potter made it into another pot, shaping it as he thought best.
Then the word of the LORD came to me:
"People of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter does?" says the LORD. "Look, like clay in the potter's hand, so are you in my hand, people of Israel.
If at any time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be pulled up, torn down, and destroyed,
and if that nation I warned turns from its evil, then I will change my mind and not bring on it the disaster I had planned.
And if at another time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be built up and planted,
and if it does evil in my eyes and does not obey me, then I will change my mind about the good I had planned to do for it.

So now tell the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, 'This is what the LORD says: Look, I am preparing a disaster for you and making a plan against you. So turn from your evil ways, each one of you, and change your ways and your actions.'
But they will reply, 'It is no use. We will continue with our own plans. Each of us will follow our own stubborn, evil heart.'"
So this is what the LORD says: "Ask among the nations: Who has ever heard anything like this? The virgin Israel has done a most horrible thing.
Does the snow of Lebanon ever leave its rocky slopes? Do its cool waters from far away ever stop flowing?
Yet my people have forgotten me. They burn incense to worthless idols. They have stumbled off the ancient paths and walk on side roads that are not built up.
Their land will become a horror, something people hiss at forever. All who pass by will be shocked and shake their heads.
Like a wind from the east, I will scatter them before their enemies. I will show them my back and not my face on the day of their disaster."

Then the people said, "Come, let us make plans against Jeremiah. We will still have priests to teach the law, wise people to give advice, and prophets to give us the word. Come, let us attack him with our words and pay no attention to anything he says."
Listen to me, LORD. Hear what my accusers are saying!
Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit to trap me. Remember how I stood before you and spoke on their behalf, to turn your anger away from them.
So let their children starve, and hand them over to the sword. Let their wives become widows with no children. Let their men be put to death, and their young men killed by the sword in battle.
Let screams be heard from their houses when you suddenly bring raiders against them. For they have dug a pit to capture me and hidden traps for my feet.
But you, LORD, know all their plans to kill me. Do not forgive their wrongdoing or wipe away their sins from your sight. Let them fall down before you. Deal with them when you are angry.
